integrity: Reproducible proof and numerical/exact test code are included. Independent review has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns symmetric stochastic matrices on Cartesian products of complete graphs with at least three factors and unequal coordinate alphabet sizes. It is a self-review mathematical argument supported by finite verification; prior general symmetry, equal-factor Hamming formulas and Cartesian-product spectral identities are expressly excluded from novelty claims. Specialized unindexed or recent association-scheme coverage is possible.
title: Unrestricted fastest mixing and holding transitions on heterogeneous clique products
